convertibility_reason: Uses only two built-in iMA indicators with standard EMA method. Simple market orders with fixed SL/TP. No external .mqh dependencies, no grid/martingale, no multi-currency, no custom indicators. All logic is straightforward crossover/under with fixed position sizing.
custom_logic_notes: The crossover detection uses index [1] and [2] (previous completed bar and bar before that), which effectively makes this a per-bar signal even though it runs on every tick. The crossover check compares bar[1] vs bar[2] values, so duplicate signals within the same bar are possible if no position check exists. The EA has NO position check — it can open unlimited positions on every tick where the crossover condition holds on the last completed bars. The digit adjustment multiplies SL and TP by 10 when _Digits==5 (5-digit broker). MAGIC number is 999. The Periods+2 parameter means the slow EMA period is 19 when Periods=17.
python_conversion_notes: Straightforward EMA crossover system. Two pandas EWM spans (17 and 19) on close prices. Crossover = fast[1]>slow[1] AND fast[2]<slow[2] for longs, reverse for shorts. Fixed lot size 0.1. SL/TP in points — remember to apply 10x multiplier for 5-digit data. No position limit exists in the original EA but for realistic backtesting, add a max_positions=1 gate to avoid opening hundreds of positions. Signal fires on completed bars only (uses [1] and [2] indices), so set intrabar_signal_behavior to once_per_bar in backtest for realistic results. Use next-bar-open fill assumption.
